title: Git City visualizes GitHub devs as 3D buildings by #gitcity #vibecoding #softwaredevelopment
description: Git City visualized a 3D city where each GitHub developer is represented as a building. Building height corresponds to the number of commits, the base width reflects repository count, and lit windows indicate recent activity, creating a dynamic digital map of developer contributions. This innovative approach combines data visualization with immersive interaction, allowing users to search for their own GitHub username and explore the city from a new perspective. The project showcases the power of vibe coding, demonstrating how large-scale, complex software can be rapidly constructed using AI-assistants like Claude Code alongside traditional IDEs such as VS Code. By turning coding into city-building, Git City offers a fresh metaphor for understanding open-source activity, fostering engagement within the developer community, and advancing creative uses of AI in programming workflows. #GitCity #GitHubVisualization #VibeCoding #ClaudeCode #VSCode #DeveloperTools #OpenSourceCommunity #DataVisualization #AIProgramming #SoftwareInnovation #CodingMetaphor #TechInnovation #DeveloperExperience #ProgrammingVisualization #DigitalCity
